content: Radiation and Your Health Radiation and Your Health Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. Feb. 15, 2024 Facts About Ultraviolet Radiation Ultraviolet (UV) radiation is non-ionizing and is emitted by both natural and artificial sources. Feb. 15, 2024 Facts About X-Rays X-rays allow healthcare providers and dentists to see if there are problems with minimal radiation. Feb. 15, 2024 Facts About Computed Tomography (CT) Scans CT scans require more exposure than x-rays, but allow your provider to see more detailed images. Feb. 15, 2024 Facts About Radiation from the Earth (Terrestrial Radiation) Radioactive materials are all around us and can be naturally found in the earth. Feb. 15, 2024 Facts About Radiation from Air Travel The amount of radiation people get from air travel is low. Feb. 15, 2024
